snapshot.baseline: legacy ORM at backend c02892a; proposed v2 logical model

records.name: app.users
records.grain: One internal UUID account mapped to one unique authentication-provider subject.

records.name: app.user_profiles
records.grain: One mutable profile per internal user.

records.name: app.consent_records
records.grain: One immutable consent decision for one document version.
records.deletion: Erase or retain only under approved legal policy; unresolved.

records.name: app.onboarding_sessions
records.grain: One expiring guest onboarding workflow with hashed proof credential.

records.name: app.onboarding_assessments
records.grain: One validated versioned assessment owned by a guest session or user, never both.
records.deletion: CASCADE with owner or approved archive classification.

records.name: app.action_plans
records.grain: One immutable plan revision for one user and local business date.
invariants: At most one current revision per user/local_date
READY implies complete publication invariant

records.name: app.action_plan_items
records.grain: One concrete action slot in one plan revision.
invariants: Unique slot per plan
Replacement links through supersedes_item_id

records.name: app.action_plan_item_variants
records.grain: One typed variant for one action item.
invariants: Unique variant type per item

records.name: app.action_item_events
records.grain: One immutable completion, skip or feedback fact.
invariants: Replay safe
Owner and item owner must match
Server records immutable decision_local_date and decision_timezone
records.notes: Unit-tested only; PostgreSQL and staging verification remains required.

records.name: app.daily_reviews
records.grain: One immutable completed Daily Review header per plan.
invariants: Exactly one review per plan
Header matches plan owner, local date and timezone
Completion answers exactly active plan items
records.notes: Unit-tested only; PostgreSQL and staging verification remains required.

records.name: app.daily_review_items
records.grain: One normalized immutable review answer per active plan item.
invariants: Reviewed item belongs to reviewed plan
Completed review items are immutable

records.name: app.plan_refreshes
records.grain: One accepted selected-variant replacement linking an old and new item across plan revisions.
invariants: Accepted operations carry immutable local_date and timezone
Old/new items share owner and local plan lineage
One old/new item can appear in at most one accepted refresh
records.notes: Selected already-published variants are implemented. Provider-backed replacement generation is not implemented or claimed.

records.name: app.streak_days
records.grain: One immutable adjudicated closed user-local day linked to one completed Daily Review or a future freeze fact.
invariants: At most one daily fact per user/local date
Daily Review evidence matches owner/date/timezone
Only earned and frozen rows qualify
records.notes: Daily Review writes earned/missed facts. Freeze allocation and consumption require owner policy and have no client command.

records.name: app.reward_ledger
records.grain: One immutable reward grant, redemption or expiration.
invariants: Balance is SUM(quantity), never stored separately
One all-completed Daily Review-derived streak fact grants one point at most once
records.notes: The only implemented grant is one point for an earned Daily Review streak fact. Redemption, expiration and freeze rewards remain pending owner policy.

records.name: app.conversations
records.grain: One typed user conversation thread.
invariants: One owner, typed status and monotonic revision

records.name: app.conversation_messages
records.grain: One ordered message in one conversation.
invariants: Replay safe per conversation
Parent conversation row is locked before sequence allocation
records.notes: User-message persistence is implemented; durable assistant response handling is pending.

records.name: app.conversation_summaries
records.grain: One versioned summary covering a recorded terminal message.

records.name: app.weekly_checkins
records.grain: One check-in per user and ISO Monday under one definition version.
invariants: Linked same-owner weekly-checkin conversation
Explicit completion requires every required response

records.name: app.weekly_checkin_questions
records.grain: One typed question in one immutable definition version.
invariants: Typed answer schema
Referenced definitions are immutable

records.name: app.weekly_checkin_responses
records.grain: One immutable response per check-in and question.
invariants: Question version matches check-in definition
answered_at is immutable

records.name: app.symptom_observations
records.grain: One timestamped structured symptom observation owned by a user.

records.name: app.media_assets
records.grain: One immutable permanent stored-object version.
invariants: Published item references only reachable approved assets

records.name: app.research_sources
records.grain: One authoritative external research source record.

records.name: app.action_item_citations
records.grain: One claim-to-source relationship for an action item.

records.name: app.ai_invocations
records.grain: One provider invocation metadata record without long-term raw health prompts.

records.name: app.plan_evaluations
records.grain: One versioned structured product-quality and safety evaluation.

records.name: ops.generation_jobs
records.grain: One durable asynchronous business job.
invariants: PostgreSQL state authoritative
Lease, heartbeat, attempts and dead letter represented

records.name: ops.outbox_events
records.grain: One domain event awaiting reliable at-least-once publication.
invariants: PostgreSQL is the sole lease and retry authority
Published and failed are terminal; failed is the dead-letter state
Consumers persist event-id deduplication before side effects
owner_user_id relation from 20260808_0009 remains intact
records.notes: No external provider is selected or deployed; deterministic fake only until runtime wiring is approved.

records.name: ops.idempotency_keys
records.grain: One actor/operation/key request hash with replayable result.

records.name: app.audit_events
records.grain: One redacted security, account or administrative event.
records.notes: DDL present in current workspace; PostgreSQL 17 execution and acceptance are unverified.

records.name: ops.deletion_requests
records.grain: One idempotent account-erasure request and terminal state.
records.notes: Resumable step ledger and pseudonymous subject HMAC are implemented locally; legal retention decision, live providers and zero-remnant staging proof remain open.

records.name: ops.account_exports
records.grain: One private, expiring portable export request linked to one job.
invariants: Ready exports hold only provider, bucket, object key, checksum and expiry; never a public URL
records.notes: Durable request and manifest contract are implemented; storage adapter and live retrieval proof remain open.

records.name: ops.deletion_steps
records.grain: One redacted verification fact for each fixed erasure scope.
invariants: Fixed ordered scopes
Verified rows carry a timestamp and no provider payload
records.notes: PostgreSQL procedure and local workflow are implemented; external adapter verification remains open.

records.name: ops.deletion_receipts
records.grain: One retained pseudonymous receipt after an app-user graph is removed.
invariants: HMAC subject fingerprint only
Allowlisted redacted verification summary
records.notes: Receipt persistence is implemented locally; legal retention approval remains an explicit blocker.

records.name: runtime.checkpoints
records.grain: Vendor-owned checkpoint row.

records.name: runtime.checkpoint_blobs
records.grain: Vendor-owned checkpoint blob row.

records.name: runtime.checkpoint_writes
records.grain: Vendor-owned pending checkpoint write row.

records.name: runtime.checkpoint_migrations
records.grain: Vendor-owned checkpoint migration marker.
